# A policy the coverage report answers for

`Policy: pol-COVR` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

Two clauses, one covered and one not, so a coverage report over this corpus has a row of each kind.

## Scope

This fixture only.

## Clauses

| Id        | Clause                                                         | Alignment |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `WRITTEN` | **MUST** be discharged by a standard, so its row reads covered |           |
| `OPEN`    | **MUST NOT** be discharged, so its row reads uncovered         |           |
